findings.finding: Exact transition-prefix tuples preserve path and depth context. Edge identity plus canonical whole-frame JSON preserves correlations and boolean/integer/null/absent-key distinctions within a call.
Cached relation steps contain no previous path history. Replay attaches steps to the current prefix history; witness materialization copies JSON payloads before returning them.
Relation summaries publish only after complete assignment enumeration and successful construction charges. Early final-goal success and budget exceptions leave incomplete entries unpublished.

Sticky uncertainty remains separate from contract_known. Empty uncertain prefixes remain unknown; a known safe existential witness can still succeed. Complete prefix summaries preserve endpoint, frontier and exact history.

Abstract enumeration, prefix-refinement learning, conservative observable traversal and terminal decision rules preserve the original structure. Added cache/history/witness work intentionally changes budget outcomes.

Explicit method-specific categories account for cache keys/lookups/statuses/publication/replay and history/witness construction. These are not uniform hardware units; preparation, string-byte costs, process memory and independent checker costs require separately scoped runtime measurements.

The retained checker independently reconstructs recipe-path witnesses and re-lifts refuted prefixes without consuming the candidate cache. No new certificate kind or trusted cache proof was introduced.
